canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, recursively sorted object keys, compact separators

trendInvalidationExit.trigger: for an open candidate position, if close(t) <= SMA180(t) computed only through close(t), mark exit
trendInvalidationExit.execution: execute marked exit at open(t+1) with ordinary exit-side cost
trendInvalidationExit.firstEvaluation: a position entered at open(t) may first be evaluated at close(t)
trendInvalidationExit.timeExit: none for candidate; original 12-session exit remains CONTROL only
trendInvalidationExit.foldBoundary: on final fold session liquidate every still-open position at that close with ordinary exit-side cost; never read next-fold open
trendInvalidationExit.reentry: while open, same-symbol entry prohibited; after executed exit, re-entry requires a new ordinary valid breakout signal

method.entry: unchanged original one-signal next-open breakout entry for both variants; Gen14 persistence not inherited
method.exit: CONTROL: 12th session close inclusive of entry; candidate: next open after close <= SMA180; both liquidate at fold end
method.control: CONTROL diagnostic only; TREND_INVALIDATION_EXIT candidate eligible
